portal-cinder-apron-north-fog.lockMessage: Superheated porcelain glaze-steam billows from the northern Slag Chasm; the Guild of Potters has sealed the bridge until the Great Damper is cooled.

portal-aphelion-buoy-north-fog.lockMessage: Sub-zero comet-tail shear sweeps the northern Outer Orbit Drift; Buoy-Keeper Astraea requires the Geode Resonance Prism before unlocking the outer mooring.

portal-bellows-hearth-north-fog.lockMessage: Scalding golden exhaust plumes vent through the Cinder Chimney Damper; the Bellows Guild requires the Master Damper Crank from Ash-Valve Vault before opening the northern flue.

portal-crown-beacon-north-fog.lockMessage: Zero-gravity star-shear along the Solstice Anchor Chain repels uncalibrated gliders; the Beacon Wardens require the Nave Aurora-Key before opening the northern anchor pier.

portal-draft-kiln-post-north-fog.lockMessage: Molten celadon glaze-vapor vents through the northern Glaze Flue; the Draft-Kiln Masons require the Bellows Counterweight Key before unbolting the northern louver.

portal-escapement-anvil-north-fog.lockMessage: Superheated solar-brass updrafts swirl around the Sun-Coil Spire; the Master Clockmakers have locked the lift until the barometer stabilizers are calibrated.

portal-inductor-switchyard-north-fog.lockMessage: Unshielded cyan corona arcs bridge the northern Corona-Arc Cliff; Switch-Master Voltair requires the Faraday Grounding Rod before opening the northern gate.

portal-lantern-hollow-west-fog.lockMessage: The western teapot-sluice bridge is shrouded in silver steam-fog; Lantern-Keepers forbid crossing until the Great Kiln is relit.

portal-patina-lock-north-fog.lockMessage: Pressurized turquoise coolant cascades over the northern Teal Spillway; the Lock-Keepers Guild has bolted the weir gate until the monsoon sluices subside.

portal-perigee-station-north-fog.lockMessage: Crushing inverted tidal shear along the Maelstrom Eye Lip snaps unreinforced tether-lines; Dive-Master Corin requires the Keel Gyro-Compass before opening the northern sea-lip.

portal-porcelain-sanctuary-north-fog.lockMessage: Boiling lotus-glaze steam curtains seal the northern Lotus Kiln Rim; Loom-Mother Cera requires the Medallion Heart-Chime before opening the northern terrace.

portal-prism-zenith-north-fog.lockMessage: Unfocused solar-eclipse rays at Apogee Lens Spire burn through unshielded gliders; the Zenith Astronomers require the Sanctum Prism-Gyro before opening the northern stair.

portal-root-roundhouse-north-fog.lockMessage: Thick golden resin webs curtain the northern Banyan Canopy Spur; Stationmaster Bramble requires the Cistern Sap-Valve Key before opening the canopy turntable.

portal-starfall-haven-north-fog.lockMessage: Upward-pouring silver cataracts at Mirror Cascade Basin have frozen the northern tether-lock; the Cartographer Guild requires the Belfry Star-Chime before unsealing the gate.

portal-undertide-sanctuary-north-fog.lockMessage: Inverted tidal pressure along the Abyssal Barometer Ridge crushes uncalibrated diving bells; the Undertide Bell-Keepers require the Cradle Star-Heart before unsealing the northern coral lock.
